people.name: Ha Eun Gyeol
people.note: CODA guitarist who time-travels from 2023 to 1995 to meet his parents as teenagers.

people.name: Ha I Chan
people.note: Hearing, cheerful teenager in 1995; loses his hearing after an accident and becomes Eun Gyeol's deaf father in 2023.

people.name: Choi Se Gyeong / On Eun Yu
people.note: Plays both Choi Se Gyeong, the cellist Ichan idolizes in 1995, and her daughter On Eun Yu, who travels back from 2023 in her place.

people.name: Yun Cheong A
people.note: Deaf, isolated artist in 1995 who becomes Eun Gyeol's mother; abused for years by her stepmother.

people.name: Lim Ji Mi
people.note: Cheong A's stepmother and chairwoman of Seowon Arts High School Foundation; abuses Cheong A for over a decade.

people.name: Ha Eun Ho
people.note: Eun Gyeol's deaf older brother.

people.name: Viva / Choi Hyun
people.note: Eun Gyeol's childhood guitar mentor, revealed to be the mysterious Time Master and Se Gyeong's biological father.

people.name: Jung Bal San
people.note: College student boarding at Ichan's grandmother's guesthouse.

people.name: O Ma Ju
people.note: Ichan's childhood friend and the band's manager; later becomes a music industry executive.

people.name: Kang Hyeon Yul
people.note: The band's bassist; a former member of a street gang.

people.name: Ko Yang Hui
people.note: Ichan's grandmother, who runs the Snail Guesthouse and raised him.

people.name: Yun Gun Hyeong
people.note: Chairman of Jinseong Musical Instruments; Cheong A's father.

people.name: Yun Ju Yeop
people.note: Cheong A's stepbrother, Ji Mi's son.

people.name: Yun Sang A
people.note: Cheong A's stepsister and Se Gyeong's friend.

people.name: On Ji Hwan
people.note: Se Gyeong's boyfriend and later husband; Eun Yu's father.

people.name: Koo Jun Hyeong
people.note: Vocalist of Spine9, Eun Gyeol's band in 2023.

people.name: Yun Dong Jin
people.note: Legendary guitarist and rock star, later Ma Ju's client.

people.name: Yeom Byeong Ho
people.note: The landlady's son, who bullied young Eun Gyeol and caused the fire that upended his family.

people.name: Byeong Ho's mother
people.note: Eun Gyeol's family's landlady in his childhood; covers for her son.

people.name: Jung Do Jin
people.note: A gang leader hunting down Hyeon Yul for betraying him.

people.name: Sin Ha Yeong
people.note: Se Gyeong's adoptive mother, struggling with depression.

people.name: Se Gyeong's dad
people.note: Se Gyeong's adoptive father.

people.name: Yun Cheong A's mother
people.note: Cheong A's biological mother, who taught her sign language before leaving.

links.label: Yoon Dong Jin and Oh Ma Ju were bandmates in 1995; Ma Ju later becomes his manager.
links.evidence: he trained with a guy called Oh Ma-joo 30 years ago

links.label: The landlady and Ha I Chan feud over a car accident her son caused.
links.evidence: she and Dad are now facing off over a recent car accident, where there's a dispute over who was driving her car

links.label: Eun Gyeol secretly teaches his teenage mother sign language, opening her to the world.
links.evidence: he convinces the Jinsung Chairman... to allow him to teach Chung-ah sign language in secret

links.label: Se Gyeong befriends the isolated, deaf Cheong A at school.
links.evidence: she befriends Chung-ah, who's otherwise a loner

links.evidence: [Se Gyeong's friend]

links.evidence: a college student at a boarding house run by Yi-chan's grandmother

links.label: Koo Jun Hyeong is the vocalist of Spine9, Eun Gyeol's band in 2023.
links.evidence: [Spine9's vocalist]

links.label: Yun Ju Yeop, jealous that Eun Gyeol has won his father's favor, tries to have him killed.
links.evidence: Joo-yeob decides to kill Eun-gyeol to eliminate him

links.label: Eun Gyeol and Eun Yu (posing as teenage Se Gyeong) fall in love in 1995.
links.evidence: Eun-gyeol decides to give in to his feelings and kisses Se-kyeong.

links.label: Ichan and Cheong A fall in love after he learns sign language to reach her.
links.evidence: he sings and signs the lyrics... she walks over and hugs him tight and not letting go

links.label: Ichan starts a band to impress Se Gyeong, his first crush in 1995.
links.evidence: Yi-chan has a crush on Se-kyung and gives her a lot of free ice-cream to charm her.

links.label: Ha Eun Ho fall fo Eun Yu in 2022, after he teaches her sign language at the hospital.
links.evidence: this is how she met Eun-gyeol's brother, Eun-ho... He taught her sign language at the hospital.

links.label: Cheong A's biological mother taught her sign language before leaving.
links.evidence: a seemingly loving mom who taught her sign language

links.label: Byeong Ho kicks a lit cigarette butt through the window, starting the fire that upends Eun Gyeol's family.
links.evidence: he kicks a burning cigarette bud which accidentally lands inside Eun-gyeol's house

links.label: Eun Gyeol learns Grandpa Viva died the same night as the fire.
links.evidence: Eun-gyeol goes to meet Grandpa Viva and learns that he had passed away on the night of the fire.

links.label: The landlady falsely tells police she was driving to protect her son.
links.evidence: The mother of the driver claims Eun-gyeol's father is lying because she was the person behind the wheel.

links.label: Eun Gyeol time-slips 29 years into the past and meets his father as a teenager.
links.evidence: Eun-gyeol is shockingly taken 29 years into the past in the year 1995... Dad?! he says.

links.label: Eun Gyeol pretends to be legendary guitarist Yoon Dong Jin to join Ichan's band.
links.evidence: Eun-gyeol lies to them and reveals that he is Dong-jin.

links.label: Ichan hides with the deaf Cheong A in a storage room, not realizing she cannot hear him.
links.evidence: Yi-chan doesn't realize Chung-ah can't hear or speak and covers her mouth so he won't get caught if she screams.

links.label: Ichan snaps at Cheong A, not knowing she really is deaf.
links.evidence: He calls Chung-a deaf, not knowing how she really did not have the ability to hear.

links.label: Eun Gyeol realizes he's about to witness the accident that will make his father deaf.
links.evidence: Eun-gyeol realising that he is about to witness his father getting into an accident which would make him lose his hearing.

links.label: Eun Gyeol kisses Eun Yu (as Se Gyeong) at a bus stop.
links.evidence: Eun-gyeol decides to give in to his feelings and kisses Se-kyeong.

links.label: Ichan dives into the ocean to save Eun Gyeol, echoing the day he'll save him again as a father.
links.evidence: Yi-chan jumps into the ocean to help Eun-gyeol from drowning just like his father did when he was younger.

links.label: Eun Gyeol tells Ichan the truth: he is his son, come from the future.
links.evidence: Eun-gyeol reveals the truth about his identity and tells Yi-chan that he is his son who had come from the future to change his life.

links.label: Do Jin and his gang ambush the band at their rehearsal hall.
links.evidence: Do-jin and his goons show up at the rehearsal hall to teach Hyun-yul a lesson... beating all the boys up.

links.label: Eun Gyeol runs out on their movie date to help the band, hurting Eun Yu.
links.evidence: he runs out — leaving Eun-yoo without a word

links.label: Eun Gyeol chases Eun Yu to the airport in the rain and asks her to stay with him.
links.evidence: he steps up next to her with a red umbrella... Stay with me. Let's stay together.

links.label: Eun Gyeol and Eun Yu discover they are both time travelers from 2023.
links.evidence: Eun-yu discovers that Eun-gyeol is the other time traveller Master was talking about.

links.label: Eun Gyeol finds Cheong A locked in a dark attic and takes her away.
links.evidence: He finds Chang-a in the dark room and breaks down.

links.label: Ichan sings and signs a song to Cheong A, confessing his feelings.
links.evidence: he sings and signs the lyrics... she walks over and hugs him tight

links.label: Ichan kisses Cheong A after she explains her sign name for him.
links.evidence: Yi-chan is touched by Chang-a's explanation and pulls her in for a kiss.

links.label: Eun Gyeol threatens to expose Ji Mi's abuse of Cheong A to the world.
links.evidence: Eun-gyeol threatens to expose Ji-mi and the entire Yoon family for treating a disabled person badly.

links.label: Yoon Geon Hyeong discovers Ji Mi's twelve years of abuse and disowns her.
links.evidence: Mr Yoon is disgusted by Ji-mi's actions and asks her to move out immediately.

links.label: Yun Ju Yeop, trying to run down Eun Gyeol, crashes into Ichan instead.
links.evidence: Joo-yeob decides to kill Eun-gyeol to eliminate him and ends up crashing into Yi-chan instead.

links.label: Ichan pushes Eun Gyeol out of the path of a speeding car and is struck himself, losing his hearing.
links.evidence: Yi-chan shows up out of nowhere, pushing Eun-gyeol away.

links.label: Before Eun Gyeol returns to 2023, Ichan leaves him a cassette promising to be his father again in the next life.
links.evidence: He promises to be Eun Gyeol's father in his next life which makes Eun-gyeol sob.

links.label: Eun Yu, posing as Se Gyeong, confronts Harabeoji about abandoning her mother.
links.evidence: she asked why he abandoned her. He cries, saying he never wanted to abandon her

links.label: Eun Gyeol realizes Master and Grandpa Viva are the same person.
links.evidence: Eun-gyeol sees that Master actually is Choi Hyun / Jonathan / Grandpa Viva.
